title: Titanium Water Bottle Cage
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Water Bottle Cage because its 900+ MPa tensile strength allows thin-wall tube shaping without buckling, critical for lightweight frame and component structures. The alpha-beta microstructure delivers 45% higher specific strength than 4140 chromoly steel, translating directly to gram-level weight savings where it matters. Its high-cycle fatigue endurance limit (>500 MPa @10^7 cycles) matches the pedaling load spectrum of Tubular titanium water bottle cage. This rationale is driven by tubular titanium water bottle cage and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for accessories geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g with SPC sampling
Go/No-Go ring gauging with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for tubular titanium water application
commonFailures: Thread galling Ti-on-Ti assembly - prevented by MoS2 anti-seize compound and -20% installation torque — critical for tubular titanium water performance

faq.q: How much weight savings does Titanium Water Bottle Cage offer versus steel or aluminum?
faq.a: Titanium Water Bottle Cage fabricated from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides a 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130 chromoly steel (4.43 vs 7.85 g/cm³) at the same strength. Compared to 6061-T6 aluminum, titanium's 3× higher yield strength (830 vs 275 MPa) allows 50-60% thinner walls, resulting in a net weight comparable to aluminum with 4× better fatigue life — critical for tubular titanium water.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Water Bottle Cage?

Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for tubular titanium water.
